still.opening: Create one photographic first frame. Compose the instant before the opening action.
still.material: Show the weight and contact of visible objects. Match highlights and contact shadows to the actual light sources.
still.avoid: Avoid duplicated props, mismatched perspective and unreadable silhouettes.

video.referenceNote: Use each reference only for its listed role.
video.visualReferences: Use location and character entries as visual guidance only. Never insert them as frames unless explicitly assigned the opening-frame role.
video.withoutOpening: Compose a new opening view from the starting state.
video.closing: Compose the closing frame from the final action and end state.
video.continuity: Preserve spatial relationships, fixed landmarks, wardrobe, prop contact and screen direction.
video.performance: Let the scripted action register through a gesture readable in this framing, or through voice or a pause when the performer is off-screen. Time any listener reaction to its cause.
video.environmentMovement: Keep fixed landmarks steady. Limit background movement to physical responses motivated by the scene.
video.negative: Avoid reversed eyelines, an early reaction and duplicated props. No subtitles or interface elements.

referenceRoles.location: set geometry, materials and light direction
referenceRoles.character: this character’s face, hair and wardrobe

flow.opening: Use the supplied image as the EXACT opening frame.

seedance.withFrame: Use Reference 1 as the exact opening frame.
